title: vibeic.ppa.power.v1 — a power measurement and where its activity came from
description: The power domain's instance document. It carries the internal / switching / leakage / total split for one scenario AND the activity basis those figures were computed on, because a vectorless estimate and a VCD-driven measurement are both 'total power' and are not the same number (PPA_INTERFACES.md §2). Two documents whose activity_basis differs are not comparable and a comparison across them is UNDETERMINED, not a winner. Versioned by filename: v1 is never edited once something has hashed against it.

scenario.description: The operating scenario these figures were measured for. Power is per scenario; a single number with no scenario is not a power result.

activity.description: Where the switching activity came from, derived from EVIDENCE in the artefact and never from the label alone. Measured 2026-08-21: 8 of the 17 published power reports declare vector_vcd and every one is falsified by its own transcript.

basis.description: VCD/SAIF/VECTORLESS are the only bases a numeric comparison may run across. UNSTATED does not match another UNSTATED: two numbers whose activity models are both unknown are not known to share one. CONTRADICTED means the artefact declares a basis its own transcript falsifies.

declared_mode.description: The token the artefact stated, kept verbatim even when it is the thing being refused.

annotated_pin_activities.description: The tool's own count. The only POSITIVE evidence in the artefact that a vector basis is real; 0 under a vector label is a contradiction.

evidence.description: The lines the basis was decided from, with line numbers, so a reader can check the verdict against the artefact rather than trusting it.

metrics.description: One vibeic.ppa.metric.v1 record per (group, category). A category the artefact does not state is present as a NOT_MEASURED row carrying a reason — never omitted, and never 0, -1 or "".

value_raw.description: The token the tool wrote. §3: hash the value you PARSED, never one you recomputed.

liberty.description: The Liberty library the figures were computed against. A measurement CONDITION: a power number at one corner's library is not the same metric as one at another's, so it lives in scope and is compared.

scope.description: The measurement's conditions. §2: two numbers are comparable only if their scope MATCHES, and `comparable()` compares every key present on either side rather than an enumerated subset — enumerating one would silently exempt whatever a later author adds here. `tool` appears here as well as in `source` because for power a different engine on a different netlist view is a different condition.

provenance.description: How well the basis is known, kept OUT of scope on purpose: it describes the confidence in the condition, not the condition itself, so it must not make two otherwise identical measurements incomparable.
